verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents first-class workflow automation: users create and trigger business workflows that notify, update, or validate information. Bank Rules can also be created and managed with match filters, and the AI page cites workflow Blueprints, so the core rule→event→action story is delivered by the product itself. The evidence is mostly marketing-level and gives no detail on which events can trigger rules or which actions they can take. missing for 10: in-depth docs on trigger event types and available actions (e.g. email alerts, field updates, webhooks, custom functions), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Trigger workflow: Easily create and trigger unique business workflows to notify, update, or validate information
